patch.sql:
with raw_lineitem as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
)

select distinct
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from raw_lineitem
patch.explanation: Added a CTE to reference the source and wrapped the SELECT in DISTINCT to remove exact duplicate rows that were causing the unique_stg_lineitem_order_line_id check to fail. This preserves all column names, types, and derived calculations while ensuring only one copy of each identical row is loaded into the staging model.
